falseSynonyms.zh: 天然不等於 green natural 表示自然形成或成分天然；天然產品不一定環保。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Natural does not automatically mean environmentally friendly.

falseSynonyms.zh: 有機不等於 green organic 在食品／農業有特定標準；不能泛指所有環保產品。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Organic is a specific production category.

falseSynonyms.zh: 健康不等於 green healthy 是對健康有益；green 是環境或植被概念。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Healthiness and environmental impact are different.

falseSynonyms.zh: 清潔／清潔能源不等於所有 green clean 有時可指低污染技術，但一般 clean 只是乾淨。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Clean overlaps only in specific environmental contexts.

falseSynonyms.zh: 可再生不等於所有 green renewable 主要指可自然補充的能源／資源。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Renewable is narrower than green.

falseSynonyms.zh: leafy 只在植物茂盛 sense 接近 green leafy 描述樹葉多，不表示環保。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Leafy is visual/vegetative, not environmental.

falseSynonyms.zh: sustainable 只在環保／長期可維持 sense 接近 green sustainable 強調長期可維持；不是所有 green 標籤都真正可持續。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Sustainability is a stronger long-term concept.

falseSynonyms.zh: 詞性與名詞陷阱 green 可作形容詞；greenery 是綠色植物／植被。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Greenery means vegetation, not environmental friendliness.
